mandatory_gates.what_is_checked: backend can produce one bounded candidate matching the existing Candidate and FileEdit contract
mandatory_gates.pass_condition: output maps cleanly to Candidate without manual repair
mandatory_gates.why_it_matters: the agent loop depends on machine-readable bounded edits

mandatory_gates.what_is_checked: candidate payloads remain parseable across the seed gate set
mandatory_gates.why_it_matters: malformed outputs should not dominate the solve path

mandatory_gates.what_is_checked: backend improves on the blocked no-backend baseline on hidden coding seed tasks
mandatory_gates.why_it_matters: a connected backend is not useful if it does not outperform the current blocked path

mandatory_gates.what_is_checked: load runtime and output failures map to explicit backend failure classes
mandatory_gates.why_it_matters: the repo is evidence-first and fail-closed

mandatory_gates.what_is_checked: exact symbolic tasks remain independent of backend generation
mandatory_gates.why_it_matters: exact deterministic routing is already a core truthfulness guarantee

mandatory_gates.what_is_checked: backend candidates still require a green VerificationReport before solve success
backend can supply initial and repair candidates or explicitly decline repair support
mandatory_gates.why_it_matters: the current agent loop already has bounded repair semantics

mandatory_gates.what_is_checked: loading and generation are stable enough on the intended Linux-first workstation path
mandatory_gates.why_it_matters: runtime fit is part of the bakeoff and cannot be bolted on later

optional_gates.what_is_checked: backend can optionally supply a post-green optimization candidate or explicitly decline cleanly
